scenes.narration: Why would Google pay Apple 20 billion dollars a year, for one setting on your phone?
Records from the U.S. antitrust trial showed Google paid Apple 20 billion dollars in 2022, to be the default search engine in Safari.
That's the search bar you use without thinking on every iPhone, iPad and Mac.
And that's just Apple. In 2021, Google spent 26.3 billion dollars on deals like this.
Why pay so much? Most people never change the default. And every single search means more ads.
